title: ARESO (Aachen Registry for Esophageal Surgery Outcomes) A prospective registry for the documentation and analysis of clinical outcomes in oesophageal surgery
summary: The ARESO Register (Aachen Registry for Esophageal Surgery Outcomes) aims to systematically document, over the long term, the clinical outcomes of patients undergoing oesophageal and gastric surgery. The aim is to collect information on new, modern surgical techniques, underlying conditions, treatment outcomes and quality of life, in order to continuously improve the quality of care and gain scientific insights. The registry is not limited to a specific research question, but serves as a growing database for various scientific analyses arising from day-to-day clinical practice over time. This is an observational study that will not involve any changes to your medical treatment.

interventions.name: Prospective, non-interventional, single-centre observational study (clinical registry) without randomisation. Continuous collection of routine clinical data. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Indication for oesophageal surgery (elective or urgent) at the Department of AVKT, RWTH Aachen University Hospital
• Written consent from the patient or their legal representative
• Sufficient language skills or the availability of an interpreter to facilitate informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
• Refusal to participate in the study
• Lack of capacity to give consent and no legal representative who can be contacted
• Emergency operations where pre-operative consent is not possible (retrospective inclusion may be possible once the patient has recovered, provided this is ethically justifiable and permissible)
